dogecoin.text: Analysts suggest altcoins may rebound once Bitcoin stabilizes. Ethereum’s performance is often a precursor to altcoin rallies, but Dogecoin could lead this cycle due to institutional interest (e.g., Grayscale’s Dogecoin fund) 413.

Ethereum (ETH) has slipped below $3,000, while XRP and Dogecoin (DOGE) are down 7.21% and 15% weekly, respectively 26.

Sui (SUI): Down 17% in 24 hours, hitting a low of $3.11 (lowest since November 2024). Technical indicators like MACD signal continued bearish momentum
